business_problem: Holiday shoppers face stress finding relevant gifts, comparing options, checking out quickly, securing delivery slots, and resolving post-purchase issues such as returns.
solution_summary: Walmart describes a multi-surface AI implementation for holiday commerce across discovery, purchase, fulfillment, and support. On Walmart.com, AI uses shopper preference and prior search signals to personalize homepage content, while a GenAI-based personalization feature in Mexico broadens product recommendations. A GenAI-powered shopping assistant and GenAI search experience interpret natural-language gift queries and return cross-category results, supported by GenAI-powered product reviews, product summarizations, and an AI-driven comparison feature to help customers evaluate items. In stores, Sam’s Club’s AI-powered exit technology uses computer vision to verify purchases as members leave. For fulfillment, an AI-driven geospatial platform unifies transaction, network catchment, customer insight, and external data into a geo-grid, and a slot optimization data science model allocates grocery delivery capacity from store labor and physical constraints. A GenAI-powered Customer Support Assistant then handles order lookup and returns.

solution_components.name: GenAI-powered shopping assistant
solution_components.role: Engages customers in natural conversations to help them discover, evaluate, and choose products.

solution_components.name: GenAI search experience
solution_components.role: Interprets use-case-based shopping queries and returns more relevant cross-category gift suggestions.

solution_components.name: GenAI-powered product reviews
solution_components.role: Uses generative AI to help shoppers assess products during the buying journey.

solution_components.name: product summarizations
solution_components.role: Condenses product information to speed customer evaluation of items.

solution_components.name: AI-driven comparison feature
solution_components.role: Compares product models such as Smart TVs to streamline purchase decisions.

solution_components.name: AI-powered exit technology
solution_components.role: Uses AI and computer vision to scan items and automatically verify purchases as members leave Sam’s Club.

solution_components.name: AI-driven geospatial platform
solution_components.role: Combines operational and external data into a geo-grid that defines store-specific delivery areas.

solution_components.name: slot optimization data science model
solution_components.role: Calculates the maximum number of online grocery orders each store can fulfill based on labor and store constraints.

solution_components.name: Customer Support Assistant
solution_components.role: Recognizes customers, finds orders, and manages returns in a more personalized support flow.

data_flow: Customer preference and search signals feed Walmart.com personalization, GenAI shopping assistance, search, reviews, summaries, and comparisons shown to shoppers on the web and app. For fulfillment, transaction data, network catchment, customer insights, and external data are unified in an AI-driven geospatial platform, while store picker availability and physical constraints feed a slot optimization model that determines delivery coverage and windows. Sam’s Club exit scans and support interactions are then served directly to members and customers.
business_outcome: Walmart reports a faster, more personalized holiday shopping experience across discovery, checkout, delivery, and returns, with broader delivery coverage and quicker Sam’s Club exits.
